title: Escrow Account Payment Timing
requirement: Landlords may elect to pay monetary relocation benefits through an escrow account established within the required 15-day period, which must disburse funds for actual relocation expenses within three working days of receiving a request.
quoted_span: Payments shall be made available within fifteen (15) days of service of the written notice of eviction; however, the landlord may, at the landlord's sole discretion and at the landlord's cost, elect to pay the monetary relocation benefits through an escrow account.
